planner_json.title: Grade a newest cell with the pinned table only when that run's own captures re-prove every required fact
provides: the re-proved mapping {table, state, basis} that runCell passes to gradeInvocation on a newest leg
consumes: E1 gradeInvocation mapping field and capture-set coverage
boundary_contracts: newest leg's captures to mapping state: the pinned table grades a newest cell only on this leg's own proof, and any other outcome reads could-not-run by name
depends_on: E1 (gradeInvocation and the capture-set coverage this reuses)
GAW-1 (runProbe, which this runs on a newest leg before grading)

write_prohibited: tests/sprint-01/** - locked; grd-03 pins the version refusal
test/harness/stream/validate-mapping.mjs - its version refusal stays; re-proof is a separate path
test/harness/stream/tables/** - only a committed table may declare a fact not applicable, and E4 to E8 own them
test/harness/graders/grade-invocation.mjs - E1's optional mapping field is the whole seam

committed_real_capture.description: The real claude-code run committed by T15: CLI 2.1.314, process exit 0, one model request, a Bash denial and a Write denial, and no question

committed_keyless_capture.description: The real keyless claude-code first turn committed by T6: CLI 2.1.312, zero model requests, no tool call and no denial

specification.objective: A newest cell with no exact-version table is graded through the pinned table only when that leg's own captures show every required fact through it, records that basis as state `reproved`, and otherwise reads could-not-run stream-mapping-unqualified naming the missing facts.
specification.success_state: A newest leg reads `reproved` with a basis citing its own capture's sha256 and one offset per fact, a renamed event reads `unqualified` naming the missing fact, and a pinned leg performs 0 re-proofs.

requirements.title: A newest cell uses the pinned table only when its own captures re-prove every required fact
requirements.description: GIVEN `committed_real_capture` at CLI 2.1.314 and `committed_keyless_capture` at 2.1.312, both real runs WHEN re-proof runs on newest legs over those captures, a renamed `permission_denials` copy and a foreign-version capture, then on pinned, exact-table and no-table legs THEN only the leg whose own capture shows every required fact reads reproved, others read unqualified naming the facts, the pinned leg performs 0 re-proofs, and no-table reads absent
requirements.positive_example: The committed 2.1.314 capture through a temp copy of the pinned table with its question facts declared not applicable reads state reproved, table claude-code@2.1.291, with a basis citing that capture's sha256 and an offset per fact.
requirements.red: On base test/harness/stream/reprove.mjs does not exist, and loadTable refuses any version with no exact table, so a newest capture can only read mapping-table-absent and this test fails.
requirements.verification_service: the real re-proof path and normaliser over committed real claude-code captures at two CLI versions

scenario.verification_service: the real re-proof path and normaliser over committed real claude-code captures at two CLI versions

would_fail_if: a stubbed re-proof returns `reproved` without reading the run's captures
a fact is counted from a capture at another CLI version

build_proof.range: anything that proves the pinned table grades a newest cell only when that same run's captures show every required fact through it, that the cell records the basis, and that a renamed event reads stream-mapping-unqualified
examples: a re-proof step that runs after a newest leg's invocations and probe, before any row is graded

steps: run re-proof on a newest leg at 2.1.312, with this untouched capture as the whole set, against the real claude-code@2.1.291 table
run re-proof on a newest leg at 2.1.314 through a temp copy of the pinned table that declares its question facts not applicable

must_observe: state `reproved`, table `claude-code@2.1.291`, observed version `2.1.314`, `0` missing facts, and a basis citing the capture's stdout sha256 and one offset per fact
a status row graded with that mapping reads no `stream-mapping-` reason

steps: in a scratch copy, rename the `permission_denials` key the way a CLI release might, and run re-proof again through that temp table
add this 2.1.312 capture to a 2.1.314 leg's set, with the 2.1.314 capture removed

must_observe: the foreign capture contributes `0` facts, and the state reads `unqualified`
must_not_observe: a fact citing a capture at another version

steps: run the same path on a pinned leg, on a newest leg whose exact version has a table, and on a newest leg with no pinned table

must_observe: the pinned leg performs `0` re-proofs, the exact-version leg reads `qualified`, and the third reads `absent` with reason `stream-mapping-absent`
must_not_observe: no state on any of the three
